desc:
THE KHA KONG – NEW MAP

Something is hunting in the dark… and it's fast.

Team up with your friends, step onto a queue pad and enter the new map together. Stay close, stay quiet, and survive the Kha Kong until the very end.

FEATURES
• Survival horror with your friends
• Brand-new map to explore
• Revive fallen teammates and keep the squad alive
• Complete lobby quests and earn coins
• Jumpscare your friends… or the whole server 😈
• Hang out in the lobby, check the donation board and show your support

HOW TO PLAY
1. Join a queue pad with your squad
2. Enter the map and stick together
3. Hide, run, survive!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to get notified about new updates!

UPDATE :
- NEW CHAPTER 3

- NEW GAME MODE
